name: GASMSIA
recent: 近期公告主要是 EPF 与 KWAP 的股东权益变动申报，未见重大企业活动。新闻方面，公司推进北马 LNG 基础设施，高庭推翻对雪州政府及 Gas Malaysia 的不利裁决，市场报道关注明年盈利复苏。
notable: 高庭推翻此前对雪州政府及 Gas Malaysia 的不利裁决。
公司推进北马液化天然气（LNG）基础设施。
EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报股东权益变动。
risks: EPF 与 KWAP 近期多次申报权益变动，持股比例可能持续调整。

recent_en: Recent announcements were mainly substantial shareholder changes by EPF and KWAP, with no major corporate exercises. In the news, the company is advancing LNG infrastructure in Northern Peninsular Malaysia, the High Court overturned a ruling against the Selangor government and Gas Malaysia, and media reports focused on an earnings recovery next year.
notable_en: The High Court overturned an earlier ruling against the Selangor government and Gas Malaysia.
The company is advancing LNG infrastructure in Northern Peninsular Malaysia.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices between October and November.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP filed multiple change notices recently, and their shareholding levels may continue to adjust.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 1,584,808,000, down 0.4% QoQ and 12.1% YoY; net income was MYR 72,529,000, down 21.9% QoQ and 26.8% YoY; net margin was 4.6%, lower than 5.8% in the previous quarter.
